_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGTRqkadkLaQzmJ9NBj9UKs)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 技能的关系规则(`rules/relationships.md`)原来只教「明细的每次写入都要主记录的编辑权,唯一开关是 `ownerMayEdit`」,现在补上第二个开关 `writeRequiresMasterRead`:打开后,能读主记录的人按明细对象自己的权限、行级与字段级安全新增、修改、删除;默认不变。同时写明三处拒绝(与 `ownerMayEdit: true` 同时声明、非 `controlled_by_parent` 对象、写在上一层)、所有权底线仍约束批量写与代他人写、相关 lint 在该明细上不报。eval 新增第 17 例。
- 为什么改:PR #33369 已在 `main` 上线这个键,技能文字却仍说「每次写入都要主记录编辑权」,AI 作者照着写会错过这个开关,或把它写到非明细对象上被拒。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字与 eval,不动 schema 与运行时;`relationships.md` token 4127 到 4127(上限 4127,零余量),新增文字由删去 lookup 与多对多示例里的两段样板父对象付账;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 的「Writes under `controlled_by_parent` — two opt-ins」一节;再看 eval 文件末尾第 17 例。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 exit 0、`relationships.md is 4127 tokens (ceiling 4127; headroom 0)`。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the rule's home.** The section "Owner edits under `controlled_by_parent` — `ownerMayEdit`" becomes "Writes under `controlled_by_parent` — two opt-ins". By default every write needs edit on the master. `ownerMayEdit: true` keeps its old meaning (the row owner's by-id update only). `writeRequiresMasterRead: true` is new: whoever reads the master inserts, updates and deletes the detail under the detail's own object permissions, RLS and FLS, re-points and each opted-in chain hop too; on behalf of another user, both users must read the master. The ownership floor (rows the caller created) still binds predicate and on-behalf-of updates and deletes (N3). Refused beside `ownerMayEdit: true`, off a `controlled_by_parent` object, and one level up (`sharing.KEY`). The lint `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in` is silent on such a detail. The code example shows the new key with "or ownerMayEdit" so the refused pair is never copied as one literal.
- Same file, two sentences the new key made incomplete: the relationship table's Sharing cell ("owner opt-in `ownerMayEdit`" to "read-on-master opt-ins (below)"), and the optional-master paragraph (setting or emptying a master asks read under `writeRequiresMasterRead`, edit even under `ownerMayEdit`).
- **Paid in the same file** (token ratchet headroom 0 before): the lookup example's parent `account` object and the junction example's two side objects (`project`, `employee`), each a name-only `ObjectSchema.create`, are replaced by one comment naming them. They taught nothing the surrounding prose and the child objects do not.
- **`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` eval 17.** Order lines anyone who can see the order may add, change or remove: `controlled_by_parent` with `writeRequiresMasterRead: true`, not `ownerMayEdit`, not one level up. `must_contain`: `controlled_by_parent`, `master_detail`, `controlledByParent`, `writeRequiresMasterRead: true`; `must_not_contain`: `sharing: { writeRequiresMasterRead`. The set already covered the master-edit rule (eval 2, `ownerMayEdit`), so the order's condition for adding one holds.
- **`.changeset/33374-skills-teach-write-requires-master-read.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines.
- Not touched, after reading each on `origin/main`: `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (its `controlled_by_parent` row says "inherited from the master record", still true), `references/lint-rules.md` (does not list the owner-policy lint), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` (an `os:check` example, no write rule stated). No restatement outside the rule's home.

## Why

Read on `origin/main` b4624440 (PR #33369 merged), not from the card's summary:

- **Key and refusals**: `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:3162-3195` (`refuseControlledByParentWriteRequiresMasterReadMisplaced`: refused off `controlled_by_parent`, refused beside `ownerMayEdit: true` with "Delete ownerMayEdit; writeRequiresMasterRead already admits the owner"), `:4244-4246` (strict `sharing` block's guidance for the key one level up), `:4210-4216` (read on the master is the master question for every write; absent or `false`, master edit).
- **Per hop and every write path**: PR #33369's body and changeset `.changeset/33250-controlled-by-parent-write-requires-master-read.md` (insert single and batch, by-id and predicate update and delete, re-point and emptying, each hop whose detail opted in; on-behalf-of asks each context). The body-named master goes through the same chain walk (`security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts:540-553`, `askBodyNamedMaster` calls `assertControlledByParentChainEditable`).
- **Ownership floor (N3)**: PR #33369 Acceptance notes ("Predicate (multi-row) update/delete keep the platform ownership floor ... only by-id writes hand that floor to the master gate"); the delegated path keeps it (`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:740-746`, `delegatorOwnWriteFloorOptions`). Confirmed identical with the #33373 ADR-0055 amendment thread (branch `claude/project-thread-mllmvl`).
- **Lint**: the changeset's `@objectstack/lint` paragraph (no new rule; the owner-policy arm stands down on a declaring detail).
- **N1**: no "byte for byte" wording; the text says "by default".

Ruling: Leehom 2026-11-14, A+ (record 6880588685 on #33250): 「开关打开后,能读主记录的人按子对象自己的授权新增、修改、删除,默认不变。」

## Acceptance notes

- **Eval id 17 collides with PR #33394** (#32392, awaiting merge), which also appends eval 17 to the same file. Whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and renumbers to 18; the order expected this.
- **Heading anchor changed**: `#owner-edits-under-controlled_by_parent--ownermayedit` is gone. `git grep` over the whole tree finds no link to it.
- **Not stated in the skill, on purpose**: the refusal shapes for a non-reader (insert and re-point `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, by-id update and delete `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`) and the lifecycle verbs. They live in the ADR amendment (#33373) and the permissions docs; the file has no headroom for them.

## Verification

Head `4629a84a`, base `origin/main` b4624440.
